method: Independent corpus-induced hierarchical grouping in order_a. First snapshot committed before second-batch reasoning and preserved unchanged. Stage two is a complete cumulative snapshot built from the first tree: extend geometry, broaden biology and physics, move Q02 to a speed child, and permit parent/root assignments for composites. No external taxonomy, application API, source edits, paid calls, other-agent output, invented answers, or paraphrased retained payloads. Component references preserve declared source order. Structural and deterministic reference-assembly checks are not semantic extraction evaluation.

limitations: Sixteen original synthetic pre-segmented questions are not representative teacher data; there is no human expert gold taxonomy or semantic correctness judgment.

A single-parent tree cannot express all cross-domain memberships. Q08 is grouped by its mathematical operation, Q13 remains at the source-analysis parent, and Q15 remains at the root. These are explicit modeling choices, not ground truth.

Taxonomy depth is uneven because only observed distinctions were introduced; first-batch categories may influence the second batch. No other ordering or agent output was inspected, so no between-order comparison is claimed.

Payload preservation is limited to exact declared component references and deterministic in-memory source-bundle assembly; it does not test AI extraction, source segmentation quality, production persistence, SVG rendering, or semantic completeness.
All answer, rubric, and points fields remain null; no answers or scoring were inferred.
No production privacy, readiness, all-domain quality, timing, or cost benchmark is established.

All local structural and reference checks passed; no execution failures occurred. The full corpus file exposed both batches, so sequential snapshot commitment is not a blinded first-batch exposure experiment.
